q: The more you feed me, the bigger I grow, but give me a drink and I'll go. What am I?
I repeat every word you say, but I have no mouth and no voice of my own. What am I?
I hold your money safe, but I also sit beside a flowing river. What am I?
I travel across the ocean without ever leaving the water, and you can also do me with your hand to say hello. What am I?
I have a peak and a foot, but I never wear a shoe or walk anywhere. What am I?
I can fly through the night using sound instead of sight, but I share my name with something you swing in a game. What am I?
I have a head and I can start a fire, but I'm not alive, and I'm also the name for two things that are exactly the same. What am I?
I have no fingers, but people slide me onto one, and I also make a sound when your phone gets a call. What am I?
I can be a season full of blooming flowers, or a coil that bounces you right back up. What am I?
I cover every tree like a coat, but a dog also makes this sound when a stranger comes near. What am I?
I can be tied on top of a present, or bent to shoot an arrow through the air. What am I?
An elephant uses me to drink and breathe, a tree stands on me, and a car keeps its spare tire in me. What am I?
I'm a part of your hand, but I'm also a tree that grows near sandy beaches. What am I?
A duck uses me to eat, but I also arrive in the mail asking you to pay money. What am I?
I sit in the center of your eye and let light in, but I also share my name with a student in a classroom. What am I?
I'm a tall bird that wades in shallow water, but I'm also a machine that lifts heavy things at a building site. What am I?
I'm a flippered animal that barks and claps, but I'm also what you do to a letter to close it shut. What am I?
I'm a fish that swims in the lake, but I'm also the deepest, lowest sound in a song. What am I?
A spider spins me between the branches, but I'm also the place you go online to find information. What am I?
I flow through a river pulling boats along, but I also flow through wires to light up your house. What am I?
I'm the smallest part of your body, but I'm also the small phone that fits in your pocket. What am I?
I tell you how loud your music is, but I'm also a fat book on a shelf. What am I?
Fish are covered in tiny versions of me, but I also tell you how much you weigh. What am I?
I'm a stack of playing cards shuffled before a game, but I'm also the flat wooden floor behind a house. What am I?
I'm how high or low a musical note sounds, but a baseball player also throws me across home plate. What am I?
Kings and queens once ruled from me, but you also bounce a basketball on me. What am I?
I can mean something that weighs very little, or something that helps you see in the dark. What am I?
I'm a straight piece of metal you can bend, but I'm also a short line of music in a song. What am I?
You lick me and stick me on an envelope, but you also do me with your foot when you're angry. What am I?
I'm a heavy metal used to build bridges, but I'm also the hot appliance that smooths the wrinkles from your shirt. What am I?
I have prongs and sit beside your plate at dinner, but a road also splits into me when it goes two ways. What am I?
I keep bugs out of your open window, but I'm also the glass part of your phone that lights up. What am I?
I'm a small furry animal that squeaks, but I also sit beside your computer keyboard and click. What am I?
I'm a short message you leave for someone, but I'm also a single musical sound. What am I?
I'm a flat piece of wood used to build a house, but I also have squares on me for playing chess. What am I?
I'm hard and flat at the end of your finger, but I'm also a metal spike a hammer pounds into wood. What am I?
I tell you the time on your wrist, but I also mean to look at something carefully. What am I?
I'm a grassy space behind a house, but I'm also a unit used to measure length, about the size of a big step. What am I?
I'm the part of your body you stand on, but I'm also a unit for measuring how long something is. What am I?
I'm a sweet fruit spread for your toast, but I also happen when too many cars are stuck on the road. What am I?
I'm a crunchy snack made from a potato, but I'm also a tiny piece that breaks off a plate or cup. What am I?
I'm a thick piece cut from a tree trunk, but sailors also keep me as a daily written record. What am I?
I'm a place filled with water where you go for a swim, but I'm also a shared collection of money everyone chips into. What am I?
I'm a group of musicians playing together, but I'm also a thin loop of rubber that holds things together. What am I?
I twinkle in the night sky, but I'm also the word for the most famous performer in a movie. What am I?
I'm a place with rides, games, and cotton candy, but I'm also the word for something that treats everyone equally. What am I?
I'm a tall wooden pole stuck in the ground, but I'm also what you call a letter once it's mailed. What am I?
I'm the rubber ring that helps a car roll, but I also describe the sleepy feeling you get after a long day. What am I?
I'm the opposite of hot, but I'm also the sickness that makes you sneeze and cough. What am I?
I'm a tiny crawling creature in the garden, but I'm also a mistake hiding inside a computer program. What am I?
